name: Gladia
tagline: Speech-to-text API for transcription, diarization, and translation.
description: Gladia provides an AI speech API for audio and video transcription with speaker diarization, translation, and real-time streaming. Developers send audio to the API and receive structured transcripts with optional multilingual and post-processing features.

auth.details: API key via x-gladia-key header (self-serve signup).

use_cases: diarize speakers in a meeting recording
translate speech transcripts to another language
